# `deposits.term_deposit.DepositTerminatedEarly`

The deposit is broken before maturity and settled net of the configured penalty (02 §2.5): NetSettlementAmount = PrincipalReturned + NetAccruedInterest − PenaltyAmount (the accrued NET interest is settled back; only the penalty is forfeited). PROMOTED to an integration event (bd t7o3.13/t7o3.13.1) so the early-termination payout's Movement reaches the substrate-owned settlement saga off the bus — the gated ACL credit replaces the old eager settle ([ADR-PC-032](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-032-money-movement-primitive.md) slot 5 / [ADR-IC-017](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-017-integration-event-promotion-criterion.md) §P4). Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers, NOT here. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2): deposit_id is an opaque reference, never depositor identity.

## Payload fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `deposit_id` | `string` (`uuid`) | DepositId (Guid) — an opaque aggregate reference, NOT depositor identity ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). |
| `principal_returned_cents` | `long` | PrincipalReturned as integer EUR cents (Money.Cents, [ADR-PC-010](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-010-dotnet-hand-rolled-engine.md) §P1) — the principal still on deposit at the break. |
| `penalty_amount_cents` | `long` | PenaltyAmount as integer EUR cents (Money.Cents) — the EFFECTIVE penalty actually charged (after the floor), non-negative. |
| `net_settlement_amount_cents` | `long` | NetSettlementAmount as integer EUR cents (Money.Cents) = principal_returned + net_accrued_interest − penalty_amount, conserved to the cent. |
| `terminated_on` | `int` (`date`) | TerminatedOn (DateOnly) as days since epoch — the as-of break date. |
| `termination_reason` | `string` | A stable, non-PII reason code (e.g. CUSTOMER_REQUEST) — never anything about the customer ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). |
| `movements` | `array<`record`>` | The early-termination payout's money movement(s) recorded append-first ([ADR-PC-032](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-032-money-movement-primitive.md) slot 5; bd t7o3.13/t7o3.13.1). A REQUIRED array (an event with no movements carries an EMPTY array, never null) defaulted to [] so pre-Movement records still decode (forward-only schema evolution, [ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P3 / BACKWARD compat). The engine's family-agnostic codec (MovementCarrier) binds this to DepositTerminatedEarly's IReadOnlyList<Movement>; the promoted ce_movementorigin / ce_movementdirections headers auto-start the substrate settlement saga. |

[ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md), [ADR-IC-017](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-017-integration-event-promotion-criterion.md), [ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md), [ADR-PC-010](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-010-dotnet-hand-rolled-engine.md), [ADR-PC-032](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-032-money-movement-primitive.md)
